model.reset: uniform over observed sample rows with WNT5A=1, retaining duplicate sample multiplicity; set WNT5A=1; reset before each fixed-H rollout
model.rule_draw: independent across nodes and plant steps; normalized max(1e-3,accuracy) weights
model.held_input_redeclaration: same held input is applied every plant step, not a one-time flip/force at macro-action start
model.feature_contract: chi=[1,WNT5A,pirin,ordered W_PREDS[:3],mean(state),mean(responsive_state),population_std(responsive_state)]; save exact indices/order and feature signature; do not assume a nominal dimension
model.measurement_target: WNT5A OFF on post-transition states; do not stop at target

training.checkpoint_timing: after complete episode and all learning updates; final checkpoint is selected, never best validation score
training.duration_at_boundary: truncate to min(scheduled,H-t); update cost is still one; keep scheduled and executed separately

evaluation.initially_targeted_states: not possible under active reset pool; assert at reset
evaluation.endpoint_record: same terminal checkpoint record supplies both table and plotted endpoint
evaluation.continuing_scope: finite-H occupancy/update measurement with resets; no stationarity or infinite-horizon feasibility claim
evaluation.multiplier_scope: stochastic actor only; never a certificate for primary greedy rows

network.initialization: torch.nn.Linear default reset_parameters, seeded by train_init stream

DDQN_PER.duplicate_priority_update: maximum absolute pre-update TD error across duplicate sampled indices + 0.001
DDQN_PER.new_priority: current maximum priority or 1 for empty buffer
DDQN_PER.importance_weight: (buffer_size*p_i)^(-beta), divided by maximum weight in sampled minibatch
DDQN_PER.terminal: fixed reset horizon reached, not first target entry
DDQN_PER.updates: one optimizer step per plant transition after buffer has >=32 items
DDQN_PER.evaluation: epsilon=0, eval mode, no gradient; exact argmax tie -> u=0

TT_AC.actor: sigmoid(theta dot chi), sigmoid argument clipped [-30,30] as source numerical map
TT_AC.score: (u-p)*chi, as inherited; declared protocol must flag sigmoid saturation derivative mismatch rather than claiming exact policy gradient there
TT_AC.reset: reset plant each episode, retain all learning parameters; terminal TD bootstraps physical final state as inherited surrogate

PD_SMAC.actor: softmax(W dot chi) over declared ordered pairs, temperature 1
PD_SMAC.dual_scaling: duration-scaled numerator per decision, not instantaneous ratio residual
PD_SMAC.eta_scope: fixed-lambda rate of R-lambda per interval, i.e. eta_reward-lambda*kappa; the +lambda*Gamma constant is omitted consistently
PD_SMAC.projection: no actor projection; multiplier lower projection only, no finite upper cap in source
PD_SMAC.reset: reset plant each episode, retain learning parameters; terminal TD bootstraps physical final state as inherited finite-reset surrogate

fixed_policies.evaluation_seed_blocks: same run-label blocks as learned comparators, but uncertainty remains conditional fixed-policy rollout uncertainty
fixed_policies.constant_input_identity_test: on the same reset and per-plant-step tape, trajectories/reward/occupancy identical across hold declarations of the same input; K may differ
